_comment: DIFF layer on top of the vendored @smogon/calc dex, keyed by the engine's species/forme name.
Most species (and, as of the 0.11 bundle, all 82 Champions Mega formes) exist in the engine with
correct data and need no entry. Add one only where Champions differs. Allowed keys per entry:
ability, types (array), baseStats ({hp, at, df, sa, sd, sp}). Everything else is taken from the engine.
Checked 19 Sep 2026: every Mega forme's engine ability matches the top ability seen on the Reg M-C
ladder except the two below. The Champions-original Z-Megas (Absol/Garchomp/Lucario-Mega-Z) and
Mega Eelektross/Scovillain have no ladder data yet and haven't been verified against an in-game source.

Staraptor-Mega._why: Engine ships Intimidate; Champions' Mega Staraptor has Contrary (community-documented, see README).

Floette-Mega._why: Engine ships Flower Veil; 97% of Reg M-C ladder Mega Floette run Fairy Aura.
